title: がくげいかいのひ (Gakugeikai no Hi)
description: Class 3 is putting on a play based on a local folk tale for the school arts festival. In this story-within-a-story, children rehearse on stage, a film crew visits to record a documentary, and a guest storyteller from Kyushu teaches them that folk tales belong to everyone. A rich story about performance, regional culture, and the power of stories.
author: オリジナル
